screen-title.purpose: The large bold title at the head of every screen; collapses to 22 sp on scroll.

hero-figure.purpose: The hero card's number (today's steps); shrinks to fit at font scale 1.3.

tile-figure.purpose: A metric tile's number, its unit set smaller beside it.

section-title.purpose: The heading over a group of settings.

shadows.name: capsule-float
shadows.purpose: Only the floating navigation capsule casts a shadow; everything else is tonal.

motion.name: fade-through
motion.purpose: Between the three tabs; a cut with Remove animations on.

motion.name: shared-axis-x
motion.purpose: Between days in Day detail; a cut with Remove animations on.

motion.name: hand-sweep
motion.value: the shortest way round, as the steppers move
motion.purpose: The dial's hands moving to a new time.

components.name: Primary pill button
components.description: The one way on at the end of a flow (Next, Save, Start).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #A68BFF; color: #1A1033; font: 600 14px/20px 'Roboto Flex', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1px; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DCD2FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tonal pill button
components.description: A secondary action on a card (Find watch, Earlier, Later).
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { background: #1F2126; color: #A68BFF; font: 600 14px/20px 'Roboto Flex', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: #2A2147; } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A68BFF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status pill
components.description: Under every screen title while the watch is fine.
components.html: Norm 2 · 82% · synced 14:32
components.css: .ds-pill-fine { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #12301F; color: #5BD98A; font: 600 14px/20px 'Roboto Flex', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Fix-it banner
components.description: Replaces the pill when something needs fixing; one fix.
components.css: .ds-banner-fix { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; background: #FFB547; color: #2A1A00; font: 500 15px/20px 'Roboto Flex', Roboto, sans-serif; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-banner-fix button { background: #2A1A00; color: #FFB547; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-banner-fix button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2A1A00; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Norm+ is a dark room with the watch in it: a near-black ground, the day's numbers on rounded cards, and the Norm 2 itself drawn live as the hero of its own tab, its physical hands where they really are, inside a violet ring with one soft glow. It is an Operate surface: Material 3 behaviour throughout, with the world lending only type, palette, density and one signature move.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, rounded cards, one violet accent
Green only for fine and goal reached; amber fix-its, red failures, always with words
Big bold titles and tabular figures in Roboto Flex
The watch drawn live as the signature
Dark first, light designed to match

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: One soft violet glow behind each screen's hero; never a second, never on content.

rules.name: The State Marks Rule
rules.body: Sending, Sent, Not sent and Waiting look the same everywhere.

rules.name: The Absent Is Absent Rule
rules.body: A figure the watch hasn't reported says so in words; never zero.

dos: Do keep green for "fine" and goals, amber for fix-its, red for failures, violet for everything you can act on.
Do say an absent figure is absent, in words; never show it as zero.
Do draw the watch as Norm+'s own drawing; don't use or imitate the watch's own screens.
donts: Don't smooth a chart, add rings, streaks or badges, or add a second glow to a screen.
Don't put protocol words, hex or terminal type on an everyday screen; Technical holds them, in the same face.
Don't break Material behaviour (Back, switches, dialogs) for the look; the world themes Material, it doesn't replace it.
